module_name: ERP token sampler and token encoders
purpose: Sample ERP patches on spherical grids and build coarse/fine token features for pair-forward pose inference.
required_adaptation: Wire to canonical-manifest dataset instead of legacy raw-data split loaders.
dependency_risks: No explicit scene-specific artifact dependency found.
recommendation: Keep as TRAIN360-v0 visual front end.

purpose: Compute coarse soft correspondences and predict coarse rotation, translation direction, and magnitude.
required_adaptation: Disable legacy anchor-dependent training options in new config.
dependency_risks: Training summaries reference a legacy tdir anchor checkpoint.
recommendation: Use as v0 core interaction block.

purpose: Predict bounded log-translation magnitude with scalar or multiscale parameterization.
required_adaptation: Retain multiscale mode but retrain on DSET2C canonical split without legacy calibration artifacts.
dependency_risks: Optional ridge/ridge_calib branches can introduce external calibration files if enabled.
recommendation: Use multiscale or equivalent bounded log_tmag head in TRAIN360-v0.

module_name: Positive scale reconstruction and log-bias clamp
purpose: Convert log-scale predictions to stable positive magnitudes with clamp/bias handling.
required_adaptation: Keep only trainable in-model bias, not legacy frozen calibration policy thresholds.
dependency_risks: Low if legacy policy files are not loaded.

purpose: Fine-stage routed correspondence refinement for rotation, direction, and scale.
required_adaptation: Use without legacy depth/calibration extras at first; optionally add observability-aware pooling.
dependency_risks: Can become overly coupled to optional depth or legacy fine-fuse settings.
recommendation: Keep optional in v0, default on only after dataloader/metrics parity is stable.

purpose: Load checkpoint and run direct pair-forward inference from canonical manifest rows.
required_adaptation: Refactor into generic TRAIN360 evaluator/export path and remove assumptions about old eval scripts.
dependency_risks: Evaluator companion currently expects world-pose fields not present in current manifests.
recommendation: Use as proof of true forward-model portability, not as final evaluator.

purpose: Frozen inference-time scale calibration policy on top of legacy T57b predictions.
required_adaptation: Only the idea is reusable; exact thresholds and policy file must not be carried into TRAIN360-v0.
dependency_risks: Legacy train-CV quantiles and S2b policy factors.
recommendation: Do not import as runtime dependency.

purpose: Bucket edges into observable/unreliable regimes for direction supervision weighting.
required_adaptation: Recompute online or from TRAIN360 train split only; remove scene01-specific feature dump dependency.
dependency_risks: Current config and artifacts are scene01/seq03 specific and tied to correspondence CSV outputs.
recommendation: Reuse the weighting logic, not the exported CSV/JSON artifacts.

module_name: S5E15 anti-parallel and scale refinement pipeline
purpose: Post-hoc refine legacy adjacent-dense exports using train-prior scale and correspondence confidence guards.
required_adaptation: Reimplement anti-parallel regularization as a train-time loss or lightweight head inside a true pair-forward model.
dependency_risks: Depends on S5E14 provenance, S5E14 weights, S5E12 correspondence feature CSVs, and scene01/seq03 paths.
recommendation: Do not use as external forward inference or TRAIN360 runtime.

purpose: Augment coarse-to-fine pair inference with rotation compensation, observability weighting, and multiframe composition.
required_adaptation: Implement only the architecture idea inside manifest-native training; do not inherit legacy scene split or train prior knobs.
dependency_risks: Current config is explicitly trained on scene01/seq01-02 and evaluated on scene01/seq03.
recommendation: Good source of v1/v2 ideas after TRAIN360-v0 is stable.

purpose: Supervise k-step composition on contiguous windows rather than random batch proxies.
required_adaptation: Bind to canonical manifest rows grouped by seq_id and timestamp order.
dependency_risks: Legacy config saves learned weights and uses scene01 split.
recommendation: Add after v0 baseline, but keep design in initial config surface.

purpose: Fuse appearance tokens with spherical geometry channels before token encoding.
required_adaptation: Integrate behind a config flag and benchmark against plain T57b encoder.
dependency_risks: Experimental path; not yet validated on canonical TRAIN360 data.
recommendation: Candidate upgrade for STRUCT360 or ARCH360, not mandatory for v0.

purpose: Build geometry-aware tokens from soft correspondences and solve for refined rotation, direction, and scale.
required_adaptation: Use only after pair-forward manifest baseline is stable and metrics are reproducible.
dependency_risks: Experimental and not tied to a finished training path in current repo.
recommendation: Defer to STRUCT360/ARCH360 rather than first TRAIN360-v0 pass.

purpose: Current train/eval pair datasets for scene/seq-scanned legacy data.
required_adaptation: Replace with a canonical-manifest-native dataset class.
dependency_risks: Internal split generation, raw-directory scanning, and non-canonical manifest format.
recommendation: Do not use for TRAIN360-v0 runtime.
